scope: Local frontend only; synthetic read-only status fixtures, no trading operations or production access.
method: Actual Chromium Three.js SkinnedMesh.getVertexPosition (including AnimationMixer, morph targets and frontend secondary motion), transformed into world space; rounded-box signed-distance tests against chair pad/back/headrest, desktop, keyboard tray/base and all keys. Every third simulated frame sampled with per-mode caps.

sourcePoseReview.method: Blender evaluated source meshes, actual runtime normalization and rounded furniture bounds.

correctionsVerified: Female hands clear jacket; fringe opens Risk Manager face.
Chair pad depths and heights fit evaluated seated cloth; chair rolls back before walking.
Desktop setback clears skirts and turning bodies.
Keyboard retracts before standing; hands align before extension; desk idle keeps resting hands above keys without typing.
Keyboard tray connects to desktop and keycaps clear fingertip pads.
Sofa/pool tops fit male and female poses; narrower pool bench clears rising trouser legs.
limitations: Finite vertex samples with 1.5 mm contact tolerance; not a proof for every continuous instant, exact triangle pairs or cloth simulation.
Office runtime probe covers local desk furniture; sofa and pool use separately evaluated source poses.
Does not establish physical iPhone/Safari performance or photorealistic likeness.
